description: Yes/no: do these part numbers fit these specific models? Example: "does 01FR025 or 5B10W13905 fit my T490 and T495?". Use get_part_fits instead to list every model one part fits. Use get_model_parts instead for a model's parts. Give part_number, part_numbers, or both (merged, duplicates dropped). At most 100 part×model pairs, else an error result. Parts match as in get_part; models resolve like get_model_parts, once each. One part: results in model order; an unknown part is an error result. Several parts: side-by-side comparison (parts list plus flat results in part-then-model order); unknown or ambiguous parts are flagged in their entry and their rows have fits null. fits true includes constraints, source_url, confidence; fits false is fit_status no_documented_fit (no document, not incompatibility); fits null for an ambiguous or unknown model. Per-row field details are in the output schema.

client.description: Optional: your agent or app name (letters and digits), used only for anonymous usage counts.

models.description: Required. 1 to 20 model slugs or full names, e.g. ["lenovo-thinkpad-t490", "ThinkPad T495"].

part_number.description: One OEM part number, with or without dashes or spaces, e.g. "01FR025" or "7K4PW". Give this, part_numbers, or both.

part_numbers.description: Several OEM part numbers to compare, e.g. ["01FR025", "5B10W13905", "L78555-005"]. Merged after part_number; parts x models must be at most 100.

name: check_part_fits

display_name.description: Short human label; not an identifier

fit_status.description: no_documented_fit: there is no fit or no result: LPF has no OEM document for it. Never means incompatible. not_asserted: a did-you-mean suggestion; no fit claim is made.

outcome.description: Always present. One field to branch on for every tool: found | no_documented_fit (identified, but no OEM-documented fit; never means incompatible) | needs_clarification (ask the user; see clarifying_question/candidates) | not_found (nothing LPF covers matches). Full contract: /api/states

title: Check a part against models
